mutations.label: M53-no-unwrapping-at-all
mutations.anchor: return {key: unwrap_scalar(value) for key, value in fields.items()}, None
mutations.why: THE DEFECT SA2b FIXES: a whole-value quoted scalar is read literally, so 17 of 31 real descriptions are priced two bytes high and quoted-scalar's phrase is buried (1558 bytes, not 1551)

mutations.label: M54-unwrapping-is-startswith-and-endswith
mutations.why: THE OPPOSITE MISTAKE: quoted-edge begins and ends with a quote and is not one scalar, so an eager strip welds it into one junk phrase and drops it out of BOTH collisions (1549 bytes, not 1551)

mutations.label: M55-a-backslash-does-not-escape-a-quote
mutations.why: quoted-scalar's first `\"` closes the scalar early, so the value stops being whole-value quoted and is read literally

mutations.label: M56-a-doubled-apostrophe-is-two-apostrophes
mutations.why: YAML's other escape: quoted-single reads 84 bytes instead of 83 and keeps an apostrophe the host never loads

mutations.label: M57-an-unterminated-quote-is-unwrapped-anyway
mutations.why: the rejected alternative: a value that opens a quote and never closes one gets its first and LAST character deleted on a guess

mutations.label: M58-only-the-description-is-unwrapped
mutations.anchor: return {key: unwrap_scalar(value) for key, value in fields.items()}, None
mutations.why: the rule stops being a fact about YAML scalars: `name: "s"` becomes a name-mismatch and `router: "true"` stops being a router
